book_name: 会心之语·专四新题型TALK答案词（2025决胜版）

words.tr: n. 问题；“problem”的复数；
words.ex: He has many problems with math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上有很多问题。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.tr: adj. 语言的；语言学的；
words.ex: He is interested in linguistic patterns in children.
words.ex_cn: 他对儿童的语言模式感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to language or linguistics.

words.tr: n. 理解；了解； v. “understand”的现在分词；
words.ex: His understanding of the problem helped solve it quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的理解帮助快速解决了它。
words.en: An understanding is a mutual agreement or sympathy between people or groups.

words.tr: n. 口音；[语]重音（accent 的复数）; v. 重读；强调（accent 的第三人称单数）
words.ex: People from different countries have different accents.
words.ex_cn: 来自不同国家的人有不同的口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.tr: phrase. 语言风格；言语表达方式
words.ex: Different cultures have different styles of speech.
words.ex_cn: 不同的文化有不同的说话方式。
words.en: Different ways of speaking, characterized by specific vocabulary, tone, or structure.

words.tr: phrase. 日常练习；日常实践
words.ex: Daily meditation is an everyday practice for many people.
words.ex_cn: 每天的冥想是许多人的日常练习。
words.en: Normal, routine activities performed in daily life.

words.tr: adj. 活跃的；积极的；主动的；
words.ex: He is an active student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上是一个活跃的学生。
words.en: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

words.tr: adj. 独立的；自主的；
words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.tr: 短语。他们各自的方式；他们自己的方法
words.ex: Each person has their own ways of dealing with stress.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有自己应对压力的方式。
words.en: Their individual methods or approaches.

words.tr: n. 目的；意图；
words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.tr: phrase. 书面信息；以文字形式记录或传达的信息
words.ex: He gave me the written information about the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我关于这次旅行的书面信息。
words.en: Data or content that is recorded in written form, such as text, documents, or symbols.

words.tr: phrase. 阅读技巧；阅读方法
words.ex: He uses good reading techniques to understand books faster.
words.ex_cn: 他使用好的阅读技巧来更快地理解书籍。
words.en: Methods or strategies used to extract meaning from text, such as skimming, scanning, or close reading.

words.tr: phrase. 对阅读的热爱；爱读书
words.ex: He has a love of reading every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都热爱阅读。
words.en: The enjoyment or enthusiasm for reading, often leading to regular engagement with books or texts.

words.tr: phrase. 不同的阅读任务
words.ex: He does different reading tasks every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做不同的阅读任务。
words.en: Various types of reading activities that require different approaches, such as reading for pleasure, study, or information.

words.tr: phrase. 略读剩余部分；快速浏览其余内容
words.ex: He started reading the first page, then skipped to skimming the rest.
words.ex_cn: 他先读了第一页，然后跳过并快速浏览了剩下的部分。
words.en: Quickly reading through the main parts of a text to get a general sense of its content without focusing on details.

words.tr: n. 译码，解码；译码，解码 v. 译（码），解（码）( decode的现在分词 )； v. 分析及译解电子信号；
words.ex: The scientist is working on decoding the secret message.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家正在从事解码秘密信息的工作。
words.en: The process of interpreting written symbols (letters, words) to understand their meaning.

words.tr: adj. 中间的；居中的；
words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.tr: n. 精炼 v. 精制; 精炼( refine的现在分词 ); 使纯净; 使文雅高尚
words.ex: He is refining his English skills every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在改进他的英语技能。
words.en: The process of removing impurities or unwanted elements from a substance, or the process of improving something by making small changes.

words.tr: phrase. 主旨；中心思想；主要观点
words.ex: The main idea of the story is kindness.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的主旨是善良。
words.en: The central point or most important concept that a writer wishes to convey in a text.

words.tr: phrase. 关键词；关键字；用于索引或检索的重要词语
words.ex: These key words help you understand the story.
words.ex_cn: 这些关键词帮助你理解故事。
words.en: Significant or representative terms that capture the essence of a topic.

words.tr: phrase. 身体的或情感的；生理的或情绪的
words.ex: He felt physical pain and emotional sadness after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到身体疼痛和情感上的悲伤。
words.en: Relating to the body or to feelings and emotions.

words.tr: phrase. 心率
words.ex: His heart rate increased after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后心率加快了。
words.en: The number of times the heart beats per minute.

words.tr: phrase. 血压
words.ex: He checks his blood pressure every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上测量血压。
words.en: The force that blood exerts against the walls of the blood vessels, especially the arteries, as it is pumped around the body by the heart.

words.tr: phrase. 直接环境；即时环境；身边环境
words.ex: He cleaned his immediate environment to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他打扫了周围的环境以保持健康。
words.en: The immediate environment refers to the surroundings or conditions in which a person, animal, or plant lives or operates, especially those that are closest and have a direct impact.

words.tr: phrase. 身体症状；生理症状
words.ex: He has physical symptoms after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后出现了身体症状。
words.en: Observable physical signs of a condition, such as illness or stress.

words.tr: phrase. 忽视他们的身体；疏于照顾他们的身体
words.ex: He is neglecting their bodies by not eating well.
words.ex_cn: 他因为饮食不好而忽视了他们的身体。
words.en: Failing to care for or pay attention to their physical health.

words.tr: phrase. +n. 忽视身体；对身体疏于照顾
words.ex: He is neglecting bodies by not eating or sleeping well.
words.ex_cn: 他因为不吃好、不睡好而忽视身体。
words.en: To fail to care for or pay attention to the physical condition of someone or something.

words.tr: adv. 消极地；
words.ex: He responded negatively to the proposal.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议持消极态度。
words.en: In a manner that is negative or pessimistic.

words.tr: phrase. 时间管理技能；指有效规划和控制时间以提高效率的能力
words.ex: He improved his time management skills to finish homework faster.
words.ex_cn: 他提高了时间管理技能，以便更快地完成作业。
words.en: The ability to use one's time effectively or productively, especially at work.

words.tr: phrase. 放松训练；一种通过系统练习使人学会降低身心紧张程度的心理或生理训练方法
words.ex: He does relaxation training every night to sleep better.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上做放松训练以更好地入睡。
words.en: A technique using exercises to reduce stress and anxiety.

words.tr: n. 冥想；
words.ex: He does meditation every morning to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冥想以放松。
words.en: Meditation is the act of remaining in a silent and calm state for a period of time, as part of a religious training, or so that you are more able to deal with the problems of everyday life.

words.tr: v. 扔；抛；
words.ex: He throws the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: Casts or propels something with a sudden, forceful motion.

words.tr: n. 命运；宿命；
words.ex: He believed his fate was to become a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己的命运是成为一名教师。
words.en: Fate is a power that is believed to control what happens in the future.

words.tr: 短语：尽了她最大的努力
words.ex: She tried her best to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 她尽了最大努力按时完成项目。
words.en: Made the maximum effort she was capable of.

words.tr: 短语动词. 尽了她最大的努力
words.ex: She done her best to finish the test.
words.ex_cn: 她尽了最大努力完成考试。
words.en: Made the maximum effort possible in a given situation.

words.tr: n. 努力；
words.ex: He made a big effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成这个项目，按时交工。
words.en: If you make an effort to do something, you try hard to do it.

words.tr: v. 获得；收割；收获；
words.ex: He worked hard and reaped the rewards.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，获得了回报。
words.en: To reap means to cut and gather a crop, or to obtain something, especially as a result of effort.

words.tr: n. 反馈
words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr: 短语. 大部分；绝大多数（通常后接名词，表示某事物的大部分内容或数量）
words.ex: I spent the most of my time reading.
words.ex_cn: 我大部分时间都在阅读。
words.en: To make the best or most advantageous use of something.

words.tr: v. 解决；
words.ex: He resolved the problem with a simple plan.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个简单的计划解决了问题。
words.en: If you resolve to do something, you make a firm decision to do it.

words.tr:
v. 行动；表现；演戏；
n. 行动；法令；
words.ex: He acted quickly to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速行动救了那个孩子。
words.en: To do something for a particular purpose or in a particular way; to behave in a particular way; to have an effect or influence on something; to perform a part in a play, film, etc.

words.tr: 短语动词. 尝试一下；试一试
words.ex: You can have a try if you want.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想要，可以尝试一下。
words.en: To make an attempt or effort to do something.

words.tr: v. 理解
words.ex: I understand the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我理解这个数学问题。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.tr: n. 指令；说明；指示；“instruction”的复数；
words.ex: Follow the instructions on the box.
words.ex_cn: 按照盒子上的指令操作。
words.en: Instructions are detailed information about how to do something, especially how to use a piece of equipment or perform a task.

words.tr: phrase. 宽松的衣服；宽大的服装
words.ex: She wears loose clothing to stay cool in summer.
words.ex_cn: 她穿宽松的衣服以便在夏天保持凉爽。
words.en: Clothing that fits loosely, allowing freedom of movement.

words.tr: n. 手套
words.ex: He wears gloves to keep his hands warm.
words.ex_cn: 他戴手套来保暖双手。
words.en: Gloves are pieces of clothing which cover your hands and wrists and have individual sections for each finger. You wear gloves to keep your hands warm or dry or to protect them.

words.tr: n. 位置；地点；
words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.tr: phrase. 灭火器；用于扑灭初期火灾的便携式设备
words.ex: The school has fire extinguishers on every floor.
words.ex_cn: 学校每层楼都有灭火器。
words.en: Portable devices designed to put out or control small fires.

words.tr: phrase. 实验室表格；实验申请表；实验记录单
words.ex: He filled out the lab form before starting the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始实验前填写了实验表格。
words.en: A document used in a laboratory to record procedures, observations, and data.

words.tr: phrase. 实验室表格；实验记录单
words.ex: He filled out the laboratory form before the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验前填写了实验室表格。
words.en: A standardized document used in a lab to record procedures, observations, and results.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.tr: phrase. 记录…的内容；做…的笔记
words.ex: He takes notes of the teacher's words in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上记下老师说的话。
words.en: To write down information for later reference or to remember it.

words.tr: phrase. 更详细的分析；更深入的剖析
words.ex: We need more detailed analysis to solve this problem.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要更详细的分析来解决这个问题。
words.en: An examination that goes into greater depth and specificity than a general overview.

words.tr: v. 修正；温习；校订；
words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.tr: v. 更改；
words.ex: He will modify the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会更改计划。
words.en: To change something slightly, especially in order to make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr: 短语. 如何克服（困难、障碍等）
words.ex: He tries to overcome his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他努力克服在公众场合讲话的恐惧。
words.en: A phrase used to ask for or provide advice on successfully dealing with difficulties, challenges, or obstacles in order to achieve a desired outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 问题的类别；问题的分类
words.ex: He sorted the categories of problems by difficulty.
words.ex_cn: 他按难度对问题类别进行了分类。
words.en: A classification of issues based on their nature, complexity, or domain, such as technical, social, or ethical problems.

words.tr: phrase. 未知的事物；陌生的领域；未被认知的部分
words.ex: The equation has one the unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程有一个未知数。
words.en: That which is not known or understood; a state of uncertainty or mystery.

words.tr: phrase. 喜欢进行各种活动；享受参与活动的过程
words.ex: Children enjoy activities at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在公园里的活动。
words.en: To take pleasure or satisfaction in participating in various pastimes or events.

words.tr: phrase. 令人满意的住宿；合意的住处
words.ex: The hotel provided satisfactory accommodation for the guests.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为客人提供了令人满意的住宿。
words.en: Satisfactory accommodation refers to lodging that meets the needs or expectations of the guests or residents.

words.tr: phrase. 表达恰当的问候
words.ex: He is expressing appropriate greetings to his new teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向新老师表达得体的问候。
words.en: The act of conveying suitable and polite salutations, such as 'hello' or 'good morning', to acknowledge someone's presence or occasion.

words.tr: adj. 语言的；语言学的；
words.ex: He is interested in linguistic patterns in children.
words.ex_cn: 他对儿童的语言模式感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to language or linguistics.

words.tr: phrase. 遭受惊吓；受到震惊
words.ex: He has a shock when he sees the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 他看到大狗时吓了一跳。
words.en: To experience a sudden and unexpected event or situation that causes a strong emotional or physical reaction.

words.tr: phrase. 结识说英语的人；与英语为母语的人见面
words.ex: He likes meeting english-speaking people at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在公园里结识说英语的人。
words.en: An event or occasion where one interacts with or encounters individuals who speak English as their primary language.

words.tr: v. 转化；翻译；
words.ex: He can translate words into pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他能把词语转化为图画。
words.en: To translate means to change written or spoken words from one language into another, or to explain something in a way that is easier to understand.

words.tr: n. 能力；才能；“ability”的复数；
words.ex: Children develop different abilities as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在成长过程中发展出不同的能力。
words.en: Abilities refer to the qualities or skills that someone has that make it possible for them to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 最有趣的
words.ex: This book is the most interesting one I've ever read.
words.ex_cn: 这是我读过的最有趣的书。
words.en: The most engaging, captivating, or noteworthy aspect of something.

words.tr: n. 总结；摘要；
words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 真实价值；真正 worth（价值）
words.ex: The true worth of the painting was only realized after the artist's death.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的真正价值只在艺术家去世后才被认识到。
words.en: The genuine, intrinsic value or importance of a person or thing.

words.tr: adj. 有吸引力的
words.ex: She is an attractive woman.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有吸引力的女性。
words.en: An attractive person or thing is pleasing or appealing to look at.

words.tr: phrase. 显著的改正；明显的修正
words.ex: The teacher made noticeable corrections on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师在他的作业上做了明显的修改。
words.en: Changes or edits that are easily seen or observed.

words.tr: n. 裁缝；
words.ex: The tailor made a new suit for the man.
words.ex_cn: 裁缝为这位男士做了一套新西装。
words.en: A tailor is a person whose job is to make men's clothes, especially suits, jackets, and trousers, that fit individual customers. As a verb, to tailor means to make or adapt something for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: n. 速记
words.ex: He wrote the note in shorthand.
words.ex_cn: 他用速记法写了这条笔记。
words.en: A method of rapid writing by means of abbreviations and symbols, used especially for taking dictation.

words.tr: v. 欺骗；作弊；
words.ex: He cheated on the test by copying answers.
words.ex_cn: 他通过抄答案来作弊。
words.en: To cheat means to act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game or examination.

words.tr: phrase. 以洞察力；有深刻见解地
words.ex: He saw the problem with insight.
words.ex_cn: 他以洞察力看出了这个问题。
words.en: With deep understanding and perception, especially of complex situations or underlying truths.

words.tr: phrase. 道德或情感上的；涉及道义或情绪的
words.ex: He felt a moral or emotional duty to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有道德或情感上的责任去帮助穷人。
words.en: Relating to principles of right and wrong behavior or to feelings of sympathy and concern for others.

words.tr: n. 洞察力；见识；
words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.tr: num. 四
words.ex: I have four apples.
words.ex_cn: 我有四个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of three and one; one more than three.

words.tr: 短语：理解问题；弄清楚问题所在
words.ex: He is understanding the problem slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在慢慢理解这个问题。
words.en: The process of comprehending the nature, causes, and implications of a specific issue or challenge.

words.tr: phrase. 制定计划；设计一个方案（指为达到某目的而仔细构思和规划）
words.ex: He is devising a plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他正在制定一个省钱的计划。
words.en: Formulating a strategy or method to achieve a specific goal.

words.tr: phrase. 以往经验；过往经历
words.ex: He used his past experience to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他利用以往的经验解决了这个问题。
words.en: Previous events or activities that have occurred in one's life, often used to inform current decisions or understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 重新陈述目标；再次阐明目的
words.ex: He will restate the goal at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他将在会议上重新陈述目标。
words.en: To express the objective or aim again, often for clarity or emphasis.

words.tr: phrase. 执行计划；实施计划
words.ex: He is conducting the plan carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他正在仔细地执行这个计划。
words.en: The process of putting a plan into action, especially in a systematic way.

words.tr: phrase. 分析经验；对经历进行系统性考察以理解其意义或改进未来行为
words.ex: He analyzes his experience to improve his skills.
words.ex_cn: 他分析自己的经验以提高技能。
words.en: To examine and evaluate one's personal or professional experiences in a structured way to gain insights or learn from them.

words.tr: v. 知道
words.ex: I know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我知道答案。
words.en: To have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it.

words.tr: n. 网站
words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.tr: n. 谈话；会话；交谈；
words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.tr: phrase. 清理；打扫；整顿
words.ex: After the party, we spent hours cleaning up the mess.
words.ex_cn: 派对结束后，我们花了几个小时清理垃圾。
words.en: The process of making a place or area tidy and free of mess or dirt.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.tr: n. 等级； v. “grade”的现在分词；
words.ex: The grading of the exam was very strict.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试的等级评定非常严格。
words.en: The process of assigning a score or rank to something, typically academic work, based on its quality or performance.

words.tr: phrase. 提出问题；询问
words.ex: She decided to ask questions to clarify her doubts.
words.ex_cn: 她决定提问以澄清她的疑惑。
words.en: Inquire about something to gain information.

words.tr: phrase. 草草记下
words.ex: He likes to jot down ideas in his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢把想法记在笔记本上。
words.en: To write or mark down quickly or briefly.

words.tr: phrase. 写下；记录下
words.ex: Please write down your name.
words.ex_cn: 请写下你的名字。
words.en: To record something in writing.

words.tr: n. 提案；建议；
words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.tr: phrase. 紧密接触；密切接触者
words.ex: He had close contact with a sick person.
words.ex_cn: 他与一位病人有密切接触。
words.en: A close contact is someone who has been near to a person infected with a disease, especially in a way that makes the transmission of the disease possible.

words.tr: phrase. 公共行为：指在公共场合中表现出来的行为举止，通常需要符合社会公德和道德规范。
words.ex: His public behavior was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他的公共行为非常礼貌。
words.en: Actions or conduct displayed in the presence of others, especially in social or official settings.

words.tr: adj. 引起烦恼的；令人不安的； v. 打扰；妨碍；“disturb”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie showed a disturbing scene of violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一个引起烦恼的暴力场景。
words.en: If you describe something as disturbing, you mean that it makes you feel anxious or upset.

words.tr: 短语动词. 进行交谈；维持对话
words.ex: They are holding a conversation in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在公园里进行对话。
words.en: The act of engaging in a verbal exchange with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 进行对话；参与交谈
words.ex: He is holding conversations with his friends every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在和朋友聊天。
words.en: The act of engaging in multiple verbal exchanges with people.

words.tr: n.对话
words.ex: They have conversations every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上都有对话。
words.en: Conversations are informal talks between two or more people in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.tr: phrase. 整体肢体语言；全身性非言语表达
words.ex: His overall body language shows he is nervous.
words.ex_cn: 他的整体肢体语言显示他很紧张。
words.en: The non-verbal signals and posture conveyed by the body as a whole.

words.tr: phrase. 非个人化的商业行为；缺乏人情味的交易；公事公办的业务
words.ex: He uses an impersonal business style to deal with clients.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种非个人化的方式与客户打交道。
words.en: A business interaction or transaction that is formal and lacks personal connection.

words.tr: phrase. 社交聚会；社交集会
words.ex: He enjoys attending social gatherings with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢参加朋友的社交聚会。
words.en: Events or occasions where people meet socially, often for leisure or networking.

words.tr: phrase. 眼神交流
words.ex: He made eye contact with the teacher during the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时与老师进行了眼神交流。
words.en: The act of looking directly into someone's eyes as a means of communication or to express interest.

words.tr: phrase. 公共演讲；公开演说；当众讲话
words.ex: He practices public speaking every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周练习公开演讲。
words.en: The act or process of making speeches in public.

words.tr: phrase. 公开演讲；公众演说
words.ex: He practices public speeches every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末练习公开演讲。
words.en: Formal addresses delivered to an audience in a public setting.

words.tr: phrase. 清晰的手势；明确的手部动作
words.ex: The teacher used clear hand gestures to explain the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用清晰的手势来讲解课程。
words.en: Distinct and unambiguous movements of the hands used to communicate meaning.

words.tr: phrase. + noun. 14间教室
words.ex: There are 14 classrooms in the school.
words.ex_cn: 学校里有14间教室。
words.en: A total of fourteen rooms used for teaching and educational purposes.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.tr: phrase. 先验知识；预先了解；事前掌握的信息
words.ex: The doctor used prior knowledge to diagnose the patient.
words.ex_cn: 医生利用先验知识诊断患者。
words.en: Knowledge that is already possessed before learning new information.

words.tr:
n. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
v. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
words.ex: The abuse of power led to many problems.
words.ex_cn: 权力的滥用导致了许多问题。
words.en: Abuse is the improper usage or treatment of a thing, often to unfairly or improperly gain benefit. Abuse can come in many forms, such as physical or verbal maltreatment, injury, assault, violation, rape, unjust practices, crimes, or other types of aggression.

words.tr: phrase. 关键性对话；重要的交流（通常指涉及敏感或复杂议题的深入沟通）
words.ex: Handling critical conversations effectively can lead to better decision-making and problem-solving.
words.ex_cn: 有效地处理关键对话可以带来更好的决策和问题解决。
words.en: Discussions that involve careful analysis, evaluation, and often challenging of ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 黑人士兵
words.ex: Black soldiers played a significant role in the American Civil War.
words.ex_cn: 黑人士兵在南北战争中发挥了重要作用。
words.en: Soldiers of African descent, particularly in historical military contexts.

words.tr: n. 经济学；经济；
words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.tr: 他们的未得到回报的努力
words.ex: Despite their unrewarded efforts, they continued to work diligently.
words.ex_cn: 尽管他们的努力没有得到回报，他们仍然继续勤奋工作。
words.en: Work or contributions that were not compensated or recognized appropriately.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭农场主；以家庭为单位经营农场的农民
words.ex: The family farmer works hard every day to feed his family and the community.
words.ex_cn: n. 家庭农场主每天努力工作，以养活他的家人和社区。
words.en: A family farmer is someone who owns or operates a farm where the labor and management are provided by that farmer and their family.

words.tr: n. 偏见；成见；
words.ex: He has prejudice against people from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 他对来自其他国家的人有偏见。
words.en: Prejudice is an unreasonable dislike of a particular group of people or things, or a preference for one group of people or things over another.

words.tr: n. 阶段；“stage”的复数；
words.ex: The project has three main stages.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目有三个主要阶段。
words.en: A stage is a particular point or period in the development or progress of something. It can also refer to a raised platform on which actors, entertainers, or speakers perform.

words.tr: v. 研究；
words.ex: He is researching how plants grow in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他正在研究植物在黑暗中如何生长。
words.en: Researching involves the systematic investigation into and study of materials and sources in order to establish facts and reach new conclusions.

words.tr: phrase. 流传副本；分发复印件
words.ex: She will circulate copies of the report tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天会分发报告的副本。
words.en: To distribute copies of a document or information to a group of people, typically for review or dissemination.

words.tr: phrase. 忘记主要思想；忽略核心观点
words.ex: He forgets main ideas when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会忘记主要观点。
words.en: Fail to remember the central points or key concepts of a discussion, text, or event.

words.tr: phrase. 匆匆看一遍；浏览
words.ex: He glanced through the magazine before the bus came.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车来之前匆匆翻看了那本杂志。
words.en: Read quickly and superficially, without paying close attention to details.

words.tr: adv. 出声地；
words.ex: He read the story aloud to his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他大声给小妹妹读这个故事。
words.en: If you say something aloud, you say it in a normal speaking voice, rather than whispering or thinking it.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；领悟；理解力
words.ex: He showed good comprehension of the simple story.
words.ex_cn: 他很好地理解了这个简单的故事。
words.en: The ability to grasp the meaning of something.

words.tr: phrase. 口头陈述；口头报告；口语展示
words.ex: He gave a spoken presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的口头演示。
words.en: A spoken presentation is the act of speaking to a group of people to explain or discuss a particular topic, often using visual aids.

words.tr: v. 排练；
words.ex: The actors rehearse their lines every evening.
words.ex_cn: 演员们每天晚上排练他们的台词。
words.en: To rehearse means to practice a play, piece of music, or other work for later public performance.

words.tr: phrase. 强有力的结尾；坚定的结局
words.ex: The movie has a strong ending.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有一个强有力的结局。
words.en: A powerful or decisive conclusion to a story or argument.

words.tr: phrase. 一个公司的文化；指企业内部的价值观、行为规范、工作氛围和共同信念等
words.ex: The company's culture values honesty and hard work.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的文化重视诚实和努力工作。
words.en: The shared values, beliefs, and behaviors that define an organization.

words.tr: phrase. 企业文化
words.ex: The company has a strong corporate culture.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有着强大的企业文化。
words.en: The set of shared attitudes, values, goals, and practices that characterizes an institution or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 顶部；顶端；最高点
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest point or part of something.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫很合我的身。
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.tr: phrase. 适合
words.ex: The new shelf does not fit into the corner.
words.ex_cn: 这个新架子放不进角落里。
words.en: If you fit into a group or situation, you seem to belong there because you are similar to the other people involved.

words.tr: v. 雇用；租用；
words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.tr: v. 雇佣；使用；
words.ex: The company will employ five new workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将雇佣五名新员工。
words.en: If a person or company employs you, they pay you to work for them.

words.tr: v. 招聘；
words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.tr: n. 面试；访谈；“interview”的复数；
words.ex: He has three interviews this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周有三场面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study, or in order to find out their opinions or experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 战略规划过程：指组织为实现长期目标而系统性地制定、评估和调整战略的流程
words.ex: The company is doing a strategic planning process for next year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在为明年进行战略规划。
words.en: A systematic approach to defining an organization's direction and making decisions on allocating its resources to pursue this direction, typically involving analysis, goal-setting, and action planning.

words.tr: phrase. 对…负责的；应解释…的原因的
words.ex: The manager is accountable for the team's mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 经理对团队的错误负责。
words.en: Responsible for something, especially in a way that requires you to explain your actions or decisions.

words.tr: phrase. 坦率而开放的；直率而真诚的
words.ex: He was frank and open about his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他坦率地承认了自己的错误。
words.en: Direct, honest, and without concealment in communication.

words.tr: adv. 立即；马上；
words.ex: He left the room immediately after the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 铃声一响，他就立即离开了房间。
words.en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

words.tr: phrase. 个人贡献；个人贡献值；个人所作的贡献
words.ex: Each student must show their individual contribution to the project.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生必须展示自己对项目的个人贡献。
words.en: The unique input or effort provided by a single person.

words.tr: n. 变化；变动；
words.ex: The weather shows a lot of variation in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天天气变化很大。
words.en: A variation is a difference or change in the usual or expected amount, level, or form of something.

words.tr: phrase. 操作字母卡片；用手移动或调整字母卡片以拼出单词或进行游戏
words.ex: He manipulates letter cards to spell his name.
words.ex_cn: 他摆弄字母卡片来拼出自己的名字。
words.en: To arrange or rearrange playing cards or similar items to achieve a specific outcome.

words.tr: n. 识别；身份证明；
words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.tr: 短语. ……的顶部；……的顶端；……的最高部分
words.ex: The bird sat at the top of the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟停在树的顶端。
words.en: The highest point or uppermost part of something.

words.tr: phrase. 字母组；一套字母；字母集
words.ex: The designer used a vintage letter set for the logo.
words.ex_cn: 设计师为这个标志使用了复古的字母组。
words.en: A complete collection of letters, often used in word games or puzzles.

words.tr: phrase. 剩余词汇；剩下的单词
words.ex: There are three remaining words to fill in the blank.
words.ex_cn: 还有三个词需要填入空白处。
words.en: Words that are left over after others have been used or removed.

words.tr: v. 挑战；质疑；“challenge”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 残障的；
words.ex: He challenged his friend to a race.
words.ex_cn: 他挑战朋友比赛跑步。
words.en: If you say that someone is challenged in a particular way, you mean that they have a disability or difficulty with something.

words.tr: v. 申请；应用；涂；敷；
words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 将单词进行分类或排序
words.ex: Please sort the words in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 请按字母顺序排列这些单词。
words.en: To organize or classify words into categories or sequences.

words.tr:
n. 姓名；名称；
v. 说出…的名字；命名；
words.ex: His name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字是汤姆。
words.en: The word or words that a person, thing, or place is known by.

words.tr: n. 重要性；
words.ex: The importance of homework is clear.
words.ex_cn: 作业的重要性是显而易见的。
words.en: The quality or state of being important; significance.

words.tr: phrase. 个人斗争；个人战役；与自己或外部困难的较量
words.ex: He fought a personal battle to overcome his fear.
words.ex_cn: 他与自己的恐惧进行了一场个人的斗争。
words.en: A personal struggle or conflict, often internal.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.tr: n. 过错；故障；缺陷；断层；
words.ex: It was his fault that the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞车是他的过错。
words.en: A fault is a mistake or a weakness in something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 完全积极的；全然正面的
words.ex: His answer is wholly positive.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答完全是积极的。
words.en: Completely favorable or beneficial with no negative aspects.

words.tr:
adj. 合作的；
n. 合作社；
words.ex: The two companies made a cooperative effort to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司合作努力解决问题。
words.en: A cooperative is an organization or business that is owned and run jointly by its members, who share the profits or benefits.

words.tr: n. 目的；“purpose”的复数；
words.ex: He bought the book for study purposes.
words.ex_cn: 他买这本书是为了学习目的。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.tr: n. 动机；动力；
words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.tr: n. 洞察力；见识；
words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.tr: phrase. 缺点和错误
words.ex: He admitted the shortcomings and errors in his report.
words.ex_cn: 他承认了报告中的缺点和错误。
words.en: Faults and mistakes.

words.tr: n. 环境
words.ex: The children are playing in their natural surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在他们的自然环境中玩耍。
words.en: The things and conditions around a person, place, or thing.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 情感支持；情绪上的安慰与鼓励
words.ex: Her dog gives her emotional support when she is sad.
words.ex_cn: 当她难过时，她的狗给予她情感支持。
words.en: Emotional support refers to the act of providing comfort, reassurance, and encouragement to someone, especially during times of stress or difficulty.

words.tr: 短语：正在与他们交谈
words.ex: He is speaking to them about the game.
words.ex_cn: 他正在跟他们谈论比赛。
words.en: Communicating verbally with other people.

words.tr: n. 呼吸； v. 呼吸；“breathe”的现在分词；
words.ex: Deep breathing helps you relax.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸有助于你放松。
words.en: The process of taking air into the lungs and expelling it; a sign of life.

words.tr: adj. 没有回应的；漠不关心的；没反应的
words.ex: The phone is unresponsive after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 手机摔了之后没反应了。
words.en: If someone is unresponsive, they do not react or respond to something such as an action, a question, or a new idea.

words.tr: phrase. 直接压力；指对某人或某事施加的明确、立即的影响或强迫
words.ex: He applied direct pressure to stop the bleeding.
words.ex_cn: 他施加直接压力来止血。
words.en: Force or influence applied directly and without intermediaries.

words.tr: phrase. 使疼痛麻木；麻痹痛苦；减轻痛感
words.ex: The medicine helps to numb the pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药有助于减轻疼痛。
words.en: Reduce or dull the sensation of physical or emotional pain.

words.tr: n.症状
words.ex: He has symptoms of a cold.
words.ex_cn: 他有感冒的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.tr: phrase. 急诊室
words.ex: He went to the emergency room after falling down.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒后去了急诊室。
words.en: The emergency room is a department in a hospital where immediate treatment is given to patients with acute illnesses or injuries.

words.tr: n. 质量；素质；品质；
words.ex: The quality of this phone is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的质量很高。
words.en: The standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.

words.tr: phrase. 使困惑并挫败；使混乱且感到沮丧
words.ex: Hard homework can confuse and frustrate students.
words.ex_cn: 困难的家庭作业会让学生感到困惑和沮丧。
words.en: To cause confusion and irritation in someone.

words.tr: n. 目标；“objective”的复数；
words.ex: His objectives are to learn English and find a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是学好英语并找到一份好工作。
words.en: An objective is something you plan to achieve, especially in business or politics.

words.tr: phrase. 合适的主题；适宜的话题
words.ex: We need to find a suitable topic for the discussion.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要为讨论找到一个合适的话题。
words.en: A suitable topic is one that is appropriate or fitting for a particular purpose or context.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.tr: n. 话题；题目；
words.ex: The topic of our talk is climate change.
words.ex_cn: 我们谈话的话题是气候变化。
words.en: A topic is a particular subject that you discuss or write about.

words.tr: phrase. 搜索引擎（复数）；用于在互联网上查找信息的软件系统
words.ex: Search engines help users find information quickly on the internet.
words.ex_cn: 搜索引擎帮助用户在互联网上快速找到信息。
words.en: Online tools that index and retrieve information from the internet based on user queries.

words.tr: 常见的问题；普遍存在的困难
words.ex: Common problems in software development include bugs and performance issues.
words.ex_cn: 软件开发中的常见问题包括错误和性能问题。
words.en: Frequent or typical difficulties or issues encountered in a particular context or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 不完整或不正确的；有缺漏或错误的
words.ex: The answer is incomplete or incorrect.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案不完整或不正确。
words.en: Lacking full details or containing errors, leading to misunderstandings or faulty outcomes.

words.tr: adj. 不明确的；含糊的；
words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.tr:
n. 主人；主持人；
v. 主持；
words.ex: The host welcomed us with tea and cookies.
words.ex_cn: 主人用茶和饼干欢迎了我们。
words.en: A host is a person who receives or entertains guests, especially in their own home. A host is also a person who presents a television or radio program.

words.tr: adj. 变迁的；过渡期的
words.ex: This is a transitional phase between childhood and adulthood.
words.ex_cn: 这是从童年到成年的过渡阶段。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a process or period of transition.

words.tr: n. 维持；维修；保养；
words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.tr: 他们的母语（复数）
words.ex: They speak their native languages at home.
words.ex_cn: 他们在家里说自己的母语。
words.en: Refers to the languages that are originally spoken by the people of a particular country or region.

words.tr: adj. 更高的；高等级的；“high”的比较级； adv. 在更高处；“high”的比较级；
words.ex: He got a higher score than his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他比他的朋友得分更高。
words.en: Higher is the comparative form of 'high', meaning at or to a greater level or degree.

words.tr: adj. 两种语言的；用两种语言的；
words.ex: He is a bilingual student who speaks English and Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个会说英语和西班牙语的双语学生。
words.en: A bilingual person is someone who can speak two languages equally well.

words.tr:
v. 努力；斗争；挣扎；
n. 努力；斗争；难事；
words.ex: He struggles to finish his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都努力完成作业。
words.en: If you struggle to do something, you try hard to do it, even though it is difficult or other people are making it difficult for you.

words.tr: n. 争论；论战；
words.ex: There was a controversy about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，人们展开了争论。
words.en: A controversy is a disagreement or argument about something that involves many people and generates strong feelings.

words.tr: adj. 只用英语的；仅限英语的
words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Exclusively using the English language.

words.tr: n.移民
words.ex: Many immigrants work hard to build a new life.
words.ex_cn: 许多移民努力工作以建立新的生活。
words.en: Immigrants are people who come to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.tr: n. 许可证；执照；
words.ex: He got a driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A license is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.tr: n. 执照；许可证；
words.ex: He got a driving licence last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾驶执照。
words.en: A licence is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.tr: phrase. 往返路线；去程和回程所经过的路径
words.ex: He took the go-return route to visit his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了往返路线去探望父母。
words.en: A route that involves going to a destination and returning along the same path.

words.tr: phrase. 入睡
words.ex: He falls asleep quickly after turning off the light.
words.ex_cn: 他关灯后很快就睡着了。
words.en: To begin to sleep.

words.tr: phrase. 打瞌睡；打盹儿
words.ex: He started to doze off during the boring meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的会议上开始打瞌睡了。
words.en: To fall into a light sleep, especially unintentionally.

words.tr: n. 护照；
words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.tr: phrase. 六个月
words.ex: He has been sick for six months.
words.ex_cn: 他病了六个月了。
words.en: A period of six months.

words.tr: phrase. 资金安全；金钱安全
words.ex: The bank uses strong passwords for money safety.
words.ex_cn: 银行使用强密码来保障资金安全。
words.en: Protection of financial assets from loss, theft, or misuse.

words.tr: adv. 定期地；经常地；有规律地；
words.ex: He visits his grandparents regularly.
words.ex_cn: 他定期去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: At consistent intervals or in a consistent manner.

words.tr: adv. 频繁地；时常；
words.ex: He frequently visits his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他经常去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If something happens frequently, it happens often.

words.tr: adv. 例行地；
words.ex: He routinely checks his email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上例行检查邮件。
words.en: If something is routinely done, it is done as a normal part of a job or process.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.tr: n.锁
words.ex: He forgot the keys to the locks.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了锁的钥匙。
words.en: Locks are devices used to secure doors, containers, etc., and can also refer to sections of a canal or river where the water level changes, controlled by gates.

words.tr: v. 保持；保留；继续；
words.ex: She keeps the room clean every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天保持房间干净。
words.en: To continue to have or hold something; to maintain a condition or position.

words.tr: n. 女用小包；钱包；资金；
words.ex: She put her keys in her purse.
words.ex_cn: 她把钥匙放进她的女用小包里。
words.en: A purse is a small bag used especially by women to carry everyday personal items.

words.tr: n. 钱包；皮夹；钱夹；
words.ex: He lost his wallet on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上丢了钱包。
words.en: A wallet is a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic, in which you can keep banknotes, credit cards, and other small flat objects.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.tr: adj. 有特权的； v. “privilege”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a privileged student who gets free books.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有特权的学生，能免费获得书籍。
words.en: Having special rights, advantages, or immunities.

words.tr: v. 发展；形成；制订；
words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.tr: n. 错配；误配；
words.ex: The mismatch between the plug and the socket caused a short circuit.
words.ex_cn: 插头和插座之间的错配导致了短路。
words.en: A mismatch is a situation in which two or more things are not well suited to each other or do not correspond to each other in the way they should.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的教室；适合学习的课堂环境
words.ex: He has a good classroom environment.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个良好的课堂环境。
words.en: A good classroom refers to a well-equipped and conducive learning environment for students.

words.tr: conj. 既…又…；两者都
words.ex: He can speak both English and Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他既能说英语又能说西班牙语。
words.en: Used to indicate that two qualities or states are both present simultaneously.

words.tr: v. 指责，责怪，归咎于( blame的现在分词 )
words.ex: She was blaming herself for the accident.
words.ex_cn: 她把事故归咎于自己。
words.en: If you blame someone for something, you think or say that they are responsible for it or that it is their fault.

words.tr: n. （与…的）密切关系；
words.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
words.ex_cn: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。
words.en: An engagement is a formal agreement to get married, or a period of time when two people are planning to get married.

words.tr: phrase. 商业媒体；以盈利为目的的传播媒介
words.ex: Commercial media shows many advertisements.
words.ex_cn: 商业媒体播放很多广告。
words.en: Media outlets that are primarily focused on generating profit.

words.tr: phrase. 所有必要步骤
words.ex: He wrote down all necessary steps to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写下了所有必要的步骤来解决这个问题。
words.en: Actions required to achieve a specific goal or result.

words.tr: phrase. 你很清楚地；你非常了解地
words.ex: You know well how to solve this problem.
words.ex_cn: 你很清楚如何解决这个问题。
words.en: An expression used to introduce a point assumed to be familiar to the listener or reader.

words.tr: adv. 身体上；物质上；
words.ex: He is physically tired after running five kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完五公里后身体上很累。
words.en: In a way that relates to the body as opposed to the mind; in a way that relates to things that can be seen or touched.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.tr: phrase. 草稿；草案；征兵；汇票
words.ex: He is reading the draft of the report.
words.ex_cn: 他正在读报告的草稿。
words.en: A preliminary version of a piece of writing or document.

words.tr: v. 转换；转变；变换；
words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.tr: phrase. 连接词；过渡词；用于连接句子或段落以表明逻辑关系的词语
words.ex: He used linking words to connect his ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他使用连接词来连接他的想法。
words.en: Words or phrases that connect ideas, sentences, or paragraphs to improve the flow of text.

words.tr: phrase. 过渡词；用于连接句子或段落，使文章结构更连贯的词语
words.ex: He used transition words to connect his ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他使用过渡词来连接他的想法。
words.en: Words or phrases that help to move from one idea to another in writing or speech.

words.tr: v. 得出结论；
words.ex: He concluded that the experiment failed.
words.ex_cn: 他得出结论说实验失败了。
words.en: If you conclude that something is true, you decide that it is true using the facts you know as a basis.

words.tr: phrase. 已完成的草稿；定稿
words.ex: He submitted the completed draft to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他把已完成的草稿交给了老师。
words.en: A final version of a written work that has been finished and is ready for review or publication.

words.tr: phrase. 你已完成的草稿
words.ex: He is solving algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在解代数题。
words.en: The final version of a document that has been fully written and edited.

words.tr: n. 标题；头衔；称号；
words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.tr: v. 支配；
words.ex: He dominates the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他主宰了谈话。
words.en: To dominate means to control or govern someone or something, or to be the most important or noticeable feature of something.

words.tr: phrase. 独特且有趣的
words.ex: This book has a unique and interesting story.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个独特而有趣的故事。
words.en: Distinctive and engaging; possessing qualities that set something apart and capture interest.

words.tr: v. 包括; 包含; 包围; 围绕( encompass的第三人称单数 )
words.ex: The book encompasses many simple ideas.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包含了众多简单的想法。
words.en: To include or contain a wide range of elements within a whole.

words.tr: phrase. 互相可理解的；彼此能听懂的（指两种语言或方言的使用者无需专门学习即可理解对方）
words.ex: Spanish and Portuguese are mutually intelligible.
words.ex_cn: 西班牙语和葡萄牙语是相互可理解的。
words.en: Capable of being understood by speakers of different dialects or varieties of a language.

words.tr: n. 殖民；殖民地化；
words.ex: The colonization of Africa by European countries happened in the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 欧洲国家对非洲的殖民发生在19世纪。
words.en: The act or process of establishing a colony or colonies.

words.tr: adj. 全球的
words.ex: The problem is a global issue.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题是一个全球性的问题。
words.en: relating to the whole world; worldwide

words.tr: phrase. 技术的和医学的
words.ex: Technological and medical advances help people live longer.
words.ex_cn: 技术和医学的进步帮助人们活得更久。
words.en: Relating to both the field of science and engineering (technological) and the field of medicine (medical).

words.tr: phrase. 共享的通用语言；指被多个群体共同使用以促进沟通的语言
words.ex: They spoke a shared common language to understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们使用一种共同的语言来互相理解。
words.en: A language used by a group for communication.

words.tr: phrase. 中心枢纽；核心节点
words.ex: The city square is a central hub for buses.
words.ex_cn: 城市广场是公交车的中心枢纽。
words.en: A central point of activity or connection.

words.tr: 名词短语，商业与科学
words.ex: He studies business and science at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习商业和科学。
words.en: The fields of commerce and scientific study.

words.tr: adj. 赞成的；有利的；嘉许的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a favorable comment on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师对我的作文给予了赞成的评价。
words.en: If something makes a favorable impression on you or is favorable to you, you like it or approve of it.

words.tr: n. 群山；山脉；“mountain”的复数；
words.ex: The hikers walked through the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者穿过了群山。
words.en: Large natural elevations of the earth's surface, often forming a range.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.tr: n. 三月
words.ex: My birthday is in March.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在三月。
words.en: March is the third month of the Gregorian calendar, following February and preceding April.

words.tr: n. 稳定化处理[退火] v. （使）稳定， （使）稳固( stabilize的现在分词 )
words.ex: The medicine is helping stabilizing his condition.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物正在帮助稳定他的病情。
words.en: The process of making something steady or stable.

words.tr: phrase. 声波（指在介质中传播的机械波，用于传递声音）
words.ex: The sound waves travel through the air.
words.ex_cn: 声波通过空气传播。
words.en: Sound waves are waves of energy that travel through the air or another medium and can be heard when they reach a person's or animal's ear.

words.tr: phrase. 动态提升的；指在运动中通过肌肉收缩产生的力量进行举升的动作，常用于健身和物理治疗领域
words.ex: He is doing dynamic lifting every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在做动态举重。
words.en: The act of lifting something with controlled, forceful movement.

words.tr: phrase. 与…有关联；与…相关；与…相联系
words.ex: This disease is associated with poor diet.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病与不良饮食有关。
words.en: If one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected in some way.

words.tr: adj. 沉思的；反射的；
words.ex: He became reflective after reading the old letter.
words.ex_cn: 他读完那封旧信后变得沉思起来。
words.en: If you are reflective, you are thinking deeply about something.

words.tr: phrase. 蓝色的或紫色的
words.ex: The sky is blue or violet at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空是蓝色或紫色的。
words.en: Having the color of the clear sky or a deep purple.

words.tr: adv.更快地（fast的比较级）
words.ex: He runs faster than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比他弟弟快。
words.en: Comparative of fast: moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.tr: v. 安排；组织；
words.ex: She will organize a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将安排一次会议。
words.en: To organize something means to arrange it in a systematic way, especially on a large scale.

words.tr: v. 组织；安排；
words.ex: She will organise a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将组织一次会议。
words.en: To organise means to arrange or plan something systematically, especially events or activities.

words.tr: n. 分心；
words.ex: The loud music was a distraction while I tried to study.
words.ex_cn: 当我试图学习时，大声的音乐让我分心。
words.en: Something that makes it difficult for you to concentrate on what you are doing.

words.tr: adj. 线性的；直线的；
words.ex: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这张图显示了时间与距离之间的线性关系。
words.en: Linear means involving or relating to a straight line or lines.

words.tr: v. 理解
words.ex: I understand the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我理解这个数学问题。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.tr: n. 信息；资料；
words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 长期记忆；长时记忆
words.ex: He remembers the story using long-term memory.
words.ex_cn: 他用长期记忆记住这个故事。
words.en: The ability to recall information over extended periods.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.tr: adj. 带…色的；有色的； v. “color”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sky turned coloured with orange and pink at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出橙色和粉色。
words.en: Coloured is used to describe something that has color or is not black and white.

words.tr: phrase. + adv. 清楚地书写；清晰地写作
words.ex: Please write clearly so that everyone can understand your message.
words.ex_cn: 请清晰地书写，以便每个人都能理解你的信息。
words.en: To express ideas in a way that is easy to understand, using straightforward language and logical structure.

words.tr: v. 分配；指派；“assign”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 指定的；
words.ex: The teacher assigned homework to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们布置了作业。
words.en: Given a specific task, role, or responsibility.

words.tr: phrase. 重要的部分；关键内容
words.ex: He wrote down the important bits of the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 他记下了讲座的重要部分。
words.en: The most significant or essential parts.

words.tr: v. 承诺；犯（罪、错）；（公开地）表达意见；
words.ex: He commit to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit means to carry out or perpetrate a mistake, crime, or immoral act; or to pledge or bind oneself to a certain course of action.

words.tr: v. 精准定位；
words.ex: The GPS can pinpoint your exact location.
words.ex_cn: GPS可以精准定位你的准确位置。
words.en: To pinpoint something means to locate or identify it precisely.

words.tr: n. 结论；结尾；
words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.tr: n. 旁边；边；面；
words.ex: The cat sat on the side of the bed.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在床的旁边。
words.en: One of the two or more parts or areas into which something is divided, or one of the two surfaces of something flat and thin, such as paper.

words.tr: phrase. 澄清任何一点；阐明任何细节
words.ex: Can you clarify any point you don't understand?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清你不理解的任何一点吗？
words.en: To make a point or idea clear and understandable.

words.tr: v. 合并；
words.ex: The company will consolidate two departments next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将合并两个部门。
words.en: To consolidate something means to make it stronger, more secure, or more solid.

words.tr: v. 比较；
words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.tr: adj. 逻辑上的；合乎逻辑的；
words.ex: His argument is logical and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点合乎逻辑，容易理解。
words.en: In accordance with the principles of logic; reasonable.

words.tr: phrase. 起源于；源自；发端于
words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To begin or derive from a particular place, source, or time.

words.tr: adj. 严酷的；严厉的；
words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.tr: n. 湿气；
words.ex: The soil has too much moisture.
words.ex_cn: 土壤中有太多湿气。
words.en: Moisture is tiny drops of water in the air, on a surface, or in a substance, that make it feel wet.

words.tr: phrase. 生长周期；指植物或生物从开始生长到成熟或完成一个生命阶段的全过程
words.ex: The growing cycle of corn takes about 90 days.
words.ex_cn: 玉米的生长期大约需要90天。
words.en: The sequence of stages through which a plant or organism passes from the beginning of its growth to the time it reproduces.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.tr: n. 文明；
words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.tr: n. 韧性；韧度；坚韧
words.ex: The boy showed toughness when he kept running despite the pain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管疼痛，这个男孩仍然坚持跑步，展现了坚韧。
words.en: The quality of being strong and not easily broken or damaged.

words.tr: v. 排斥; 击退( repel的现在分词 ); 使厌恶; 推开
words.ex: The magnets are repelling each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些磁铁相互排斥。
words.en: The action of pushing something away or causing it to move away.

words.tr: phrase. 预防瘟疫；防止鼠疫
words.ex: The doctor tried to prevent the plague with clean water.
words.ex_cn: 医生试图用干净的水来预防瘟疫。
words.en: To stop the plague from happening or spreading.

words.tr:
v. 牺牲；
n. 牺牲（品）；
words.ex: He sacrificed his time to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他牺牲了自己的时间来帮助朋友。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.tr: phrase. 回顾与反思；复习与思考
words.ex: He did a review and reflection after the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试后做了回顾和反思。
words.en: A process of examining and thinking deeply about something to gain understanding or make improvements.

words.tr: phrase. 跳过几行（文字或代码）
words.ex: He skipped some lines in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他跳过了作业中的几行。
words.en: To intentionally leave blank spaces or gaps in written text for organizational or aesthetic purposes.

words.tr: adj. 左边的；左手的
words.ex: He uses his left-hand hand to write.
words.ex_cn: 他用左手写字。
words.en: Situated on or relating to the side of a person or thing that is to the west when they are facing north.

words.tr: adj. 看得见的；显眼的；
words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的底部；在……的最下端
words.ex: The cat is at the bottom of the box.
words.ex_cn: 猫在盒子的底部。
words.en: Located at the lowest part or position of something.

words.tr: adj. 保留的； v. 保留；“reserve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The seats are reserved for students.
words.ex_cn: 这些座位是为学生保留的。
words.en: If something is reserved, it is kept specially for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: adj. 适用的；适合的；
words.ex: This rule is applicable to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: If something is applicable to a particular situation, it is relevant or suitable for that situation.

words.tr: adj. 耗时的
words.ex: Doing homework by hand is time-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 手写作业很耗时。
words.en: If you describe an activity as time-consuming, you mean that it takes a lot of time to do.

words.tr: adj. 系统的；有条理的；
words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A systematic approach or method is one that is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way.

words.tr: adj. 教育的；有教育意义的；
words.ex: This is an educational video for children.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个为儿童制作的教育视频。
words.en: Educational means relating to education or the process of education.

words.tr: phrase. 改进；改善；提高
words.ex: The weather is expected to improve over the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 预计周末天气会好转。
words.en: To make something better or more effective.

words.tr: adj. 以主题为中心的；以学科为中心的
words.ex: The curriculum is designed to be subject-centered, focusing on the core subjects of math, science, and language arts.
words.ex_cn: 该课程设计以学科为中心，重点放在数学、科学和语言艺术等核心学科上。
words.en: Focusing on the topic or content rather than the learner's needs or interests.

words.tr: n. （与…的）密切关系；
words.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
words.ex_cn: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。
words.en: An engagement is a formal agreement to get married, or a period of time when two people are planning to get married.

words.tr: n. 兴趣；利益；“interest”的复数；
words.ex: His interests include reading and painting.
words.ex_cn: 他的兴趣包括阅读和绘画。
words.en: Interests refers to the feeling of wanting to know or learn about something or someone, or activities that you enjoy doing in your spare time.

words.tr: phrase. 劳动密集
words.ex: This farm is labor-intensive because it needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场是劳动密集型的，因为它需要很多工人。
words.en: Requiring a large amount of labor relative to capital.

words.tr: phrase. 暴露于……的；面临……的
words.ex: The workers were exposed to harmful chemicals.
words.ex_cn: 这些工人暴露在有害化学物质中。
words.en: Having been made aware of or experienced something, often for the first time.

words.tr: adj. 可转移的；
words.ex: Her skills are transferable to other jobs.
words.ex_cn: 她的技能可以转移到其他工作上。
words.en: If something is transferable, it can be moved or passed from one person, place, or situation to another.

words.tr: phrase. 学习风格
words.ex: Different students have different learning styles.
words.ex_cn: 不同的学生有不同的学习方式。
words.en: Learning styles refer to the preferred ways in which individuals absorb, process, comprehend, and retain information.

words.tr: phrase. 需求分析；对需求进行的系统评估与研究
words.ex: The first step in the project was conducting a needs analysis to understand the client's requirements.
words.ex_cn: 项目的第一个步骤是进行需求分析，以了解客户的需求。
words.en: The process of identifying and evaluating the requirements or gaps in knowledge or skills of a learner or group.

words.tr: adj. 熟练的；精通的；
words.ex: He is proficient in playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他弹钢琴很熟练。
words.en: If you are proficient in something, you can do it well because you have learned how to do it.

words.tr: n. 观念；认知；“perception”的复数；
words.ex: His perceptions of success are different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对成功的观念与我的不同。
words.en: The way in which something is regarded, understood, or interpreted.

words.tr: n. 结果；成果；“outcome”的复数；
words.ex: The outcomes of the experiment were surprising.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验的结果令人惊讶。
words.en: The results or consequences of actions or events.

words.tr: n. 态度；姿势（复数形式）；
words.ex: His attitudes toward homework are very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, especially as shown by your behavior.

words.tr: n. 约束；限制；拘束；“constraint”的复数；
words.ex: The budget puts constraints on our spending.
words.ex_cn: 预算对我们的支出施加了限制。
words.en: Constraints are things that limit or restrict what you can do.

words.tr: v. 估价；评价；
words.ex: The shopkeeper will evaluate the old watch.
words.ex_cn: 店主将估价这块旧手表。
words.en: If you evaluate something or someone, you consider them in order to make a judgment about them, for example about how good or bad they are.

words.tr: phrase. 图形图表
words.ex: Using visual diagrams can help students understand complex concepts more easily.
words.ex_cn: 使用视觉图表可以帮助学生更容易地理解复杂的概念。
words.en: Representations using pictures, charts, or graphics to convey information visually.

words.tr: n.教练
words.ex: The instructors taught the kids how to swim.
words.ex_cn: 教练们教孩子们如何游泳。
words.en: An instructor is a person whose job is to teach a practical skill or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 评估数据；评定资料
words.ex: The assessment data provided valuable insights into the students' performance.
words.ex_cn: 评估数据为学生的表现提供了有价值的见解。
words.en: Information or statistics gathered and used to evaluate performance or progress.

words.tr: n. 标题；头衔；称号；
words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 更合适的；更恰当的
words.ex: This method is more appropriate for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这种方法更适合初学者。
words.en: Better suited or more fitting for a particular situation or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 说实话；讲真话
words.ex: He can tell the truth to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他可以对他的老师说实话。
words.en: To speak honestly; to not lie or deceive.

words.tr: adj. 困难的
words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难。
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.tr: n. 作业；任务；
words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.tr:
adj. 清楚的；明确的；清晰的；清澈的；晴朗的；
v. 清空；清除；放晴；使明确；
adv. 清楚地；彻底地；
words.ex: The instructions are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很清楚。
words.en: Free from anything that marks or darkens; transparent; bright; not obscure or ambiguous; easily understood; free from guilt or blame.

words.tr: n. 失望；挫折；伤心
words.ex: He felt disappointment when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 当他考试没及格时，他感到失望。
words.en: A feeling of sadness or displeasure caused by the nonfulfillment of one's hopes or expectations.

words.tr: phrase. 损害控制；危机管理；减轻损失的措施
words.ex: The company did damage control after the scandal.
words.ex_cn: 丑闻发生后，公司进行了危机公关。
words.en: Actions taken to limit or repair the negative consequences of a mistake or problem.

words.tr: n. 失败
words.ex: He felt sad after the failure of his business.
words.ex_cn: 他的生意失败后，他感到很难过。
words.en: The lack of success in achieving or doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 真正的好奇心；发自内心的求知欲
words.ex: His genuine curiosity made him ask many questions.
words.ex_cn: 他真正的好奇心让他问了很多问题。
words.en: Genuine curiosity refers to a sincere and authentic desire to learn or know about something.
